source_trace: Pinned middleware constructs LangChainToolExecutor and supplies it as RecoveryManager.action_executor. The adapter returns status=error on invocation exceptions or a missing tool. Core rollback ignores that returned result and marks the record compensated. Selected core unit tests cover raised exceptions, not this adapter-produced error result. This trace is not a full middleware execution.
